newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan utility, oil firms to raise prices -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan utility, oil firms to raise prices -- paper.

text.p: Japanese gas and electric power companies are expected to raise utility fees from January while oil wholesalers are expected to boost prices of their oil products for their November shipments due to a recent rise in crude oil prices, a Japanese newspaper said on Thursday.

Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc, for example, was expected to charge about 20 yen more per household in January compared with October, the economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said. The rise in Japanese oil wholesalers' prices for November shipments was expected to be two to three times the size of the hike in their October shipments, the paper said.
